passkeys.intro: With a passkey you sign in using your fingerprint, face or device PIN – no password or PIN to type. It is safer than a password, and your password manager can sync it to your other devices.
passkeys.sharedHint: Shared device (e.g. kitchen or bar tablet)? Then do not store a personal passkey here: anyone who can unlock the device could use it. Sign in with your PIN instead, or use the passkey on your own phone via QR code.

order.title: Order
order.text: Tap a free table (or “New order”), tap the items, “Send to kitchen/bar”. Then you are back here, and the table is yours by itself (“My table”).

bring.text: When a table turns green, something is ready. Pick it up and bring it to the table. After 10 min it counts as brought by itself.

pay.title: Cash out
pay.text: Tap the table, “Cash out”. Everything is already selected. Paying separately: “Pay separately”.

shiftEnd.title: End of shift
shiftEnd.hint: Signs out all guest phones. Anyone who wants to order afterwards scans the QR code on their table again. Orders and bills stay as they are.
shiftEnd.confirmBody: Guests at the tables just scan the QR code again. Phones that have left the festival can no longer order.

pricing.priorityHint: When promotions overlap, each item gets the lowest price; discounts never add up. At the same price the promotion naming the item itself wins. A promotion only lowers a price, never raises it.

tables.title: Tables
tables.hint: Add or remove tables at any time, also during the event. A table with an open bill cannot be removed.
tables.open: Tables {tables} still have open bills. Settle them first.

depositEnabled.label: Deposit
depositEnabled.hint: Deposits are charged with the items and paid back with "Return deposit".
depositEnabled.more: Waiters get the "Return deposit" button for it, also for sales without a table. Off: no deposit, even if items have a deposit value.

staffMealsEnabled.label: Helper / staff meals
staffMealsEnabled.hint: Waiters can book free orders for helpers (with a reason).

waiterCallsEnabled.label: Call the service
waiterCallsEnabled.hint: Guests can call the service to their table.
waiterCallsEnabled.more: With a reason: pay, order or question. The table's waiter sees it first, after 2 minutes everyone in service; the bar screen shows every call. Off: the button is gone.

buzzer.label: Buzzers at the kitchen and bar
buzzer.hint: A big button at the counter: one press finishes the oldest order.
buzzer.more: The buzzer works like a one-key keyboard (USB or Bluetooth). With buzzers, the station's screen shows one lane per buzzer: the oldest order, large, for the person at that buzzer. A press finishes it and the lane takes the next one. A second press within a second is ignored. Up to four buzzers per station.
buzzer.sameKey: Another buzzer at this station already uses this key.

foodPrepayEnabled.label: Pay for food when ordering
foodPrepayEnabled.hint: The kitchen only gets food once it is paid.
foodPrepayEnabled.more: So food runners can hand it out without cashing. Guests' food (QR code) waits until a waiter has cashed it; the table shows "Food to cash". Drinks are still paid when they are brought.

cashDrawerEnabled.label: Cash drawer per waiter
cashDrawerEnabled.hint: Each waiter counts their change float at the first payment.
cashDrawerEnabled.more: At the end they count the cash; the app works out what should be there. Off: nobody needs to open a drawer.

cafeClosed.label: Cake counter closed
cafeClosed.hint: New orders of coffee and cake go to the kitchen.
cafeClosed.more: For after the coffee hour. What is already at the counter is still finished there. The counter can also close and reopen itself.

join.linkHint: One link for everybody: scan, enter a name, wait. You let each person in here. Only valid while this event is active.

guestLimits.title: Guest order limits
guestLimits.hint: Most one guest phone may have ordered and not yet paid, so nobody can walk past a table and load it with orders. Paid orders no longer count. Empty = no limit.
guestLimits.invalid: Enter an amount of at least €1, or leave the field empty.

branding.title: Design
branding.short: Name, date, logo, colours, welcome, legal notice
branding.text: Name and date are already there. Upload a logo, pick the colours and write a short welcome for the guests. Further down go the legal notice and privacy policy; guests see them as links.

settings.title: Settings
settings.text: Check which table numbers there are. Then switch on only the features you really use, such as deposit or helper meals: whatever is off does not show anywhere. The order limits guard against prank orders from passers-by.

menu.title: Menu
menu.text: Enter every item with its price and pick where it is made: kitchen, bar or cake counter. The quickest way is the Excel template: download, fill in, upload again.

pricing.title: Promotions
pricing.short: Happy hour and other timed prices
pricing.text: Only needed when some prices are lower for a while, such as a happy hour. Otherwise just go on.

staff.title: Helpers
staff.text: Create the join link. Put up its QR code or send the link to the helpers' group. Whoever opens it enters their name, and you let them in here with their role. The link works once the event is active.

qr.title: QR codes
qr.text: Download the QR codes for all tables as a PDF and print them. Guests scan the code on their table and order from there. Below that is a cheat sheet per role to lay out, with the join QR code for new helpers.

start.title: Rehearsal & start
start.short: Practise first, then start for real
start.text:
1. Tap "Activate" at the top.
2. Below, "Start rehearsal": all helpers order, prepare and cash up to practise.
3. "End rehearsal" deletes the test orders. From then on everything counts.

cheatSheet.title: Cheat sheet for the helpers
cheatSheet.hint: One A4 page per role to lay out: the three steps and “What if …”. The page for the service carries the join QR code.
cheatSheet.failed: Could not create the cheat sheet.

lead.overview: The grid shows every table. Green means: something is ready and must go to the table.
lead.assign: Tap a table and hand it out. Each waiter finds their tables under “My table”.
lead.fix: Paying money back: tap the table, then “Refund” at the item. Only you or an admin may void finished items.

i1.q: The table belongs to someone else?
i1.a: Tap “Take over table” or ask the shift lead.

i2.a: In the table, tap “Void” at the item. If it is already done, the shift lead helps.

i3.a: Log in again on another device. Nothing is lost.

i1.a: Check “Sound” at the top and keep the screen on.

i2.a: Tap “Sold out” at the top. Then nobody can order it.

i3.a: Tap “Undo” at the bottom right away. Too late? Tell the waiter.

i4.a: Call out the order number. The guest picks it up.

i1.a: Free their tables or give them to another waiter.

i2.a: Open the table, tap “Refund” at the paid item.

i3.a: Let them scan the join QR code on the service page and let them in in the admin.

cheatSheet.joinText: Scan with the phone camera, enter your name and wait until you are let in.
cheatSheet.joinMissing: No join link yet. Create one in the “Helpers” tab and download the cheat sheet again.

offline.title: No connection
offline.text: The app is installed, but orders and payments need an internet connection. Please check your connection and reload.

lanes.free: Free – the next order lands here.
lanes.cut: Not everything fits – zoom out in the display menu (screen icon at the top).

cafe.closeConfirm: Close the cake counter? New orders of coffee and cake then go to the kitchen.
cafe.closedBanner: Cake counter closed: new orders go to the kitchen.
cafe.kitchenBanner: Cake counter closed: coffee and cake now come here.
cafe.toastClosed: Cake counter closed, the kitchen takes over.

guide.title: How it works
guide.arrive: New orders appear here by themselves. It beeps and the screen edge lights up.
guide.arriveVibrate: New orders appear here by themselves. The device vibrates and the screen edge lights up.
guide.arriveSilent: New orders appear here by themselves. The screen edge lights up.
guide.start: Prepare it. "Start preparing" is optional: the guest then sees "Preparing".
guide.done: When everything is ready, tap "all done". The service sees it at once. Wrong tap? "Undo" shows briefly at the bottom.
guide.soldOut: When something runs out, tap "Sold out" at the top. Then nobody can order it.
guide.cafeClose: After the coffee hour, tap "Close cake counter" at the top: new orders then go to the kitchen.

alerts.label: Alerts
alerts.flashHint: The screen edge lights up for every new alert, also when silent.
alerts.noVibration: This device cannot vibrate: only the screen lights up.
alerts.lockedBanner: Tone is still off. Tap here once so new alerts beep.

legal.missing: No text has been provided for this event yet.
